business_scope.primary_industry_name: Social Commerce via Short Video Platforms

meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English-derived, supplemented by locally enacted Gibraltar statutes)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: UK-Gibraltar Double Taxation Arrangement (1970, as amended and updated in 2019)
UK-Gibraltar Tax Co-operation and Exchange of Information Arrangement (post-Brexit transitional framework)
OECD/G20 Inclusive Framework on BEPS participation (Gibraltar is a participating jurisdiction)
Hague Convention of 5 October 1961 Abolishing the Requirement of Legalisation for Foreign Public Documents (Apostille Convention), extended to Gibraltar by the United Kingdom

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Proceeds of Crime Act 2015 (Gibraltar), Part III (as amended); Criminal Justice (Money Laundering) Regulations 2019 (as amended); Gibraltar Sanctions Act 2019 and associated Sanctions Regulations; Limited Partnerships Act 2016 (Gibraltar), ss. 4, 5, 7 and 31; Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2018; Registered Agents and Corporate Service Providers Act 2007; GFSC AML/CFT Rules and Guidance Notes (2023 edition)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each individual partner and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country passport authority; final certification by a Gibraltar Notary Public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing for each corporate partner and general partner entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country Companies Registry or equivalent authority of the corporate partner

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source of funds confirmation for each contributing partner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relationship bank or licensed financial institution of the partner

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified board resolution of each corporate partner authorizing formation of and contribution to the Exempted Limited Partnership
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate partner board of directors; notarization by a Gibraltar Notary Public

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all partners, UBOs, authorised representatives and signatories against the UN Consolidated List, UK HM Treasury Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List (best-practice secondary screening), and the domestic Gibraltar Sanctions List. Enhanced due diligence (EDD) is compulsory for politically exposed persons (PEPs), family members and close associates under GFSC AML/CFT Rules and Guidance Notes; continuous monitoring and event-triggered re-screening are required at least annually for low-risk structures and at any material change of ownership for this TikTok Shop retail scope.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Gibraltar Companies House / Registry of Companies (official e-Services portal: www.companieshouse.gi)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory names must be registered in English using the 26-letter Latin script; no official transliteration requirement applies to Arabic, CJK or other scripts, which may be used only as unofficial trading names. The name must not be misleading, offensive, or imply a connection with the Crown, H.M. Government of Gibraltar, or any public authority unless ministerial consent is obtained.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a proposed name, the applicant (through its licensed Gibraltar registered agent or legal counsel) must file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Companies within 21 days of the rejection notice. The appeal must set out legal grounds, including any asserted compliance with the Limited Partnerships Act 2016 ss. 5 and 7 and the Companies Act 2014 naming provisions, and must propose a revised name or justify the original name. The Registrar must issue a decision within 14 business days of receipt. A further administrative review may be requested from the Registry Appeals Panel of the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission, and an ultimate application for judicial review may be filed in the Gibraltar Supreme Court under the Civil Procedure Rules 2000.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for formation purposes. The Limited Partnerships Act 2016 and the Registered Agents and Corporate Service Providers Act 2007 require a physical registered office and a licensed registered agent in Gibraltar. A virtual-office or mail-forwarding address cannot satisfy the statutory registered office requirement for an Exempted Limited Partnership; the physical office must be staffed and capable of receiving service of process.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 15% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection for a low-risk retail e-commerce ELP with a licensed registered agent; the likelihood rises to 25-35% where the structure requires PEP-related enhanced due diligence or where the Financial Intelligence Unit and GFSC have issued increased supervisory scrutiny for pass-through partnerships with predominantly non-resident partners.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Gibraltar Companies House / Registry of Companies

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Limited Partnerships Act 2016, calculated by reference to authorized capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent appointment and formation administration (year 1)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for licensed trust and corporate service providers

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT KYC, PEP and sanctions screening package (per UBO and general partner)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent / Gibraltar compliance officer

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and Hague Apostille bundle (4 documents including passport, good standing, bank reference and board resolutions)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary fee plus government apostille tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal opinion, name clearance advice and commercial substance guidance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for commercial legal advisory work

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Statutory UBO Central Register initial filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Gibraltar Financial Services Commission / Registry of Companies

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Limited Partnerships Act 1927 (Gibraltar), as amended; Companies Act 2014 (Gibraltar) ss. 5, 24, 53; Limited Partnerships (Accounts) Regulations 2021
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Gibraltar Companies House, Registry of Companies and Partnerships, Financial Services Commission (GFSC)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form LP1 — Application for Registration of an Exempted Limited Partnership
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an Exempted Limited Partnership; the partnership agreement may specify capital contributions, and a contribution escrow account must be established in Gibraltar when initial capital is payable before registration
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the General Partner, acting for and on behalf of the Exempted Limited Partnership, hereby adopts the Partnership Agreement and approves the subscription of partnership interests by the initial Limited Partner(s) in accordance with the capital schedule. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the Partnership shall be situated at the address of the licensed corporate service provider in Gibraltar and that the corporate service provider is authorised to file all statutory documents. RESOLVED FURTHER that the individuals named in the registration application are appointed as the designated officials responsible for AML/CFT compliance and that the General Partner is authorised to execute all opening bank and payment-rail documents on behalf of the Partnership.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of licensed corporate service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) licensed corporate service providers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Gibraltar-licensed CSP to act as General Partner or as registered agent. Provide certified passport copies, proof of address, references, and source of funds. Execute the CSP engagement letter and complete customer due diligence before any filing is submitted.
required_dossiers: Certified passport of each partner/beneficial owner
Proof of residential address (utilities or bank statement)
Bank reference letter and professional reference
Source of wealth and source of funds statements
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the GFSC or CSP issues a know-your-client query, promptly file supplementary source-of-funds evidence and a statement explaining commercial purpose; escalate to the CSP’s compliance officer for internal review and resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two ranked proposed names using the registry’s name reservation portal. The name must end with 'Limited Partnership' or the permitted abbreviation 'LP'. Ensure the name is not identical or confusingly similar to existing corporate names and avoids restricted words such as 'Trust', 'Royal', or 'Assurance' without GFSC consent.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation (if any) for parent entity
Written consent from any regulated body if a restricted name is used
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused due to similarity, select the reserve name and resubmit, or file an appeal with the Registrar under the Companies Act within 14 days, including consent or disclaimer letters from the objecting entity if applicable.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of partnership agreement and capital escrow declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: CSP registered office in Gibraltar / escrow bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Finalise the Limited Partnership Agreement executed by the General Partner and Limited Partner(s). If capital is payable at registration, open or designate a client money escrow account with a Gibraltar-licensed bank or payment institution. Confirm the aggregate capital contribution, drawdown conditions, profit-sharing ratios, and the pass-through tax allocation clause. Obtain a certification from the escrow bank stating the funds are held irrevocably for the partnership.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank delays the escrow certification, obtain a temporary undertaking letter and submit the registration while the final confirmation is pending, then deliver the confirmation to the Registry as a supplementary filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Form LP1 and designated official declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies House / Registry of Companies and Partnerships
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form LP1 together with the executed partnership agreement and declarations. List the General Partner (which may be a Gibraltar company or licensed CSP), the registered office, the nature of business as 'Internet retail sale via social media platforms (ISIC 4791)', and the designated representatives under the Proceeds of Crime Act. Pay the official registration fee. Obtain the electronic Certificate of Registration.
required_dossiers: Declaration by General Partner of lawful purpose
Identity verification documents of all partners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a query or rejection notice within 5 business days, respond with amended pages or supporting declarations within the stated deadline (usually 14 days); incomplete filings may be reinstated upon payment of a fixed late corrective fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration for tax, VAT, and economic substance notification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Income Tax Office and Customs & Excise Department; GFSC for substance declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a Gibraltar tax reference number for the ELP. Register for VAT under the Value Added Tax Act 2010 if annual taxable turnover is expected to exceed the registration threshold. File the annual Economic Substance Report through the GFSC system, indicating the core income-generating activity category related to e-commerce distribution and confirming that the marked substance test is satisfied via the Gibraltar director and management arrangements.
required_dossiers: Certificate of registration of the ELP
Identity documents of General Partner and designated officials
Economic Substance Notification and Report form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax office assigns a late or incomplete file, provide the certificate and activities schedule immediately; any penalty for late VAT or substance filing can be mitigated by submitting a letter of voluntary disclosure and the relevant returns before enforcement.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-formation compliance — register of partners, accounting records, and AML appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: CSP registered office / Gibraltar Financial Intelligence Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Maintain a register of partners and beneficial owners at the registered office. Adopt a risk-based AML procedure covering social commerce counterparties and payment-rail monitoring. File the annual return with Companies House and ensure the accounting records satisfy section 44(2) of the Limited Partnerships Act 1927. Confirm the appointment of a MLRO / Compliance Officer for the partnership.
required_dossiers: Register of Partners and beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where regulatory infractions are discovered post-registration, submit a retrospective report to the GFSC / GFIU and update the register; the remedial filing will be accepted absent wilful default.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: HM Customs and Excise, Gibraltar Business and Licensing Office (for non-regulated retail activity)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial operating licence required for remote e-commerce retail under ISIC 4791

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection and Research Unit (Gibraltar) — Department of the Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no industrial installation, manufacturing process, or physical warehouse in Gibraltar; digital social-commerce activity only
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the pure intermediary digital retail operation; if fulfilment or logistics storage is later added in Gibraltar, compliance with the Pollution Prevention and Control Regulations for volatile organic compound (VOC) storage and the Waste Regulations 2011 would apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable — no physical premises, fire safety inspection, or structural load certification required for the Gibraltar-registered ELP engaging exclusively in online marketplace retail via TikTok Shop. Any future Gibraltar-based office or warehousing would require a fire safety certificate and workplace notification to the Gibraltar Health and Safety Inspectorate.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Income Tax Office (Commissioner of Income Tax) under the Income Tax Act 2010 (as amended) for direct taxes, and HM Customs Gibraltar (Customs and Excise Division) for VAT; official access via the Government of Gibraltar portal at www.gibraltar.gov.gi and the online tax/VAT filing systems.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the ELP under the Limited Partnerships Act 2015 (as amended) with the Gibraltar Registrar of Companies to obtain the statutory registered number. Step 2: File the partnership particulars and Form A1 with the Income Tax Office; submit the ELP deed, registered-office certificate, general partner details, and partner ownership schedule to obtain the Gibraltar Tax Reference Number (TRN), issued within approximately 5 business days. Step 3: Where taxable turnover exceeds or is expected to exceed the VAT threshold, apply for a Gibraltar VAT identification number online via HM Customs Gibraltar (Form V1), appending bank references, projected supply data, and the ELP deed; the VAT certificate issues within 15 working days. The TRN and VAT number constitute the statutory TIN/VAT ID pair; a resident tax agent or responsible general partner must be designated for compliance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Pass_Through_Eligible — the ELP is fiscally transparent under the Income Tax Act 2010; profits and losses are attributed pro rata to the general and limited partners; territorial taxation limits Gibraltar exposure for non-resident partners without Gibraltar-source income or a permanent establishment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists in Gibraltar; fiscal transparency is mandatory for the ELP. Available elections include: (a) designation as an exempt private fund under the Limited Partnerships Act 2015; (b) appointment of the responsible general partner or a resident tax representative for filings; (c) partnership-agreement election to consolidate partnership results into one partner's computation where commercial conditions meet the group/consortium criteria; and (d) treaty-tie-breaker considerations for hybrid entities under the UK-Gibraltar double taxation arrangement. Hybrid mismatch elections are not available; BEPS Action 2 automatic adjustments apply.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: GBP 85,000 annual taxable turnover in Gibraltar pounds (compulsory registration within 30 days of exceeding; voluntary registration permitted), subject to cross-border nexus: TikTok Shop retail sales to UK/EU consumers are further tested under online-marketplace deemed-supplier and distance-selling thresholds in the destination state.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No CTC (continuous transaction control), real-time fiscal clearance, API stamping, or e-invoice authorisation is currently mandated in Gibraltar; VAT invoices may be issued in standard electronic or paper format and must be retained for six years. VAT returns and supporting records must be lodged electronically through HM Customs Gibraltar's online system, with digital-preservation obligations aligned to OECD record-keeping standards.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to physical goods exported from Gibraltar to a destination outside the Gibraltar customs territory within three months of supply, and to qualifying international services supplied to customers outside Gibraltar, provided that: title passes to an overseas buyer; the ELP retains conclusive evidence of export (customs entry, transport contract, courier tracking, and merchant settlement records); the TikTok Shop order and payment data identify the overseas destination; and the supplier files the zero-rated supply on its VAT return. Refund of residual input VAT is obtained through the periodic VAT return process.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
Gibraltar electronic export entry (outward declaration) lodged with HM Customs Gibraltar
Commercial invoice referencing the TikTok Shop order ID and ISIC 4791 goods description
TikTok Shop Payout settlement statement and Wise B2B FX confirmation evidencing receipt of export proceeds
Packing list with courier airway bill or bill of lading proving physical departure from Gibraltar
Buyer location evidence (delivery address and transaction records) preserved for six years
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Zero-rating claims are subject to retrospective reassessment by HM Customs Gibraltar for up to six years, with extended assessment windows in cases of deliberate fraud; defective or missing export evidence triggers denial of zero-rating, clawback of any input VAT claimed, civil penalties up to 100% of the VAT at risk, interest, and criminal prosecution for evasion, with joint and several liability extending to the general partner and tax agent. The Income Tax Office cross-references export declarations, TikTok Shop payouts, and Wise B2B settlement records to detect hybrid-mismatch and circular-funds fraud; fraudulent refunds are recoverable with sanctions including disqualification of the ELP's general partner.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) as banking and financial services regulator; Bank of England as the ultimate monetary authority for sterling; Government of Gibraltar issues Gibraltar pound banknotes at par with GBP.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Gibraltar pound (GIP) is pegged 1:1 with GBP; both current account and capital account payments are fully convertible with no exchange-control quotas. Profit remittances from an Exempted Limited Partnership are treated as pass-through distributions at the partner level and face no statutory repatriation tax or FX conversion barrier. The practical compliance hurdle is not convertibility but the transparent demonstration of underlying trade substance, source of funds, and platform settlement documentation under GFSC AML/CFT standards.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender rules exist in Gibraltar. Export and social-commerce redemption proceeds may be retained in any permitted currency, although GFSC-regulated banks apply enhanced transaction monitoring to USD and multi-currency inflows. For any single inbound remittance exceeding GBP-equivalent EUR 10,000, the bank requires a supporting commercial document such as a TikTok Shop settlement statement or commercial invoice; there is no mandatory conversion ratio.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Medium-High for day-to-day settlement accounts using GFSC-authorised or FCA-authorised digital EMIs such as Wise and Revolut, provided the ELP maintains a registered office in Gibraltar and valid partner identification. Legal constraints: UK FCA-authorised EMIs do not have automatic passporting rights into Gibraltar post-Brexit; any EMI operating in Gibraltar must be separately licensed by GFSC under Gibraltar's financial services framework. TikTok Shop payouts may be received through EMI accounts, but a physical or regulated Gibraltar bank account is recommended for capital escrow and high-value trade settlements because EMIs may impose lower aggregate transaction limits and stricter payment-purpose screening on social-commerce proceeds.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is generally permitted for non-resident partners and beneficial owners via secure video-conference, provided passports, apostilled partnership documents, and certified register-of-beneficial-owners extracts are submitted. However, at least one natural person—typically the nominated general partner representative or compliance officer—must maintain a verifiable presence or registered address in Gibraltar for service of process. Certain bank onboarding procedures require one in-person identity interview for capital escrow accounts, especially when the underlying customer is a non-EU tax-resident connected partnership; otherwise remote video KYC interviews are accepted by most Tier-1 Gibraltar banks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity arising from multi-tiered corporate partners
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Register of Beneficial Owners filed with the Gibraltar Registrar, partnership deed, certificate of limited partnership, certificate of incumbency, notarised passports, proof of residential address, and a written ownership-structure breakdown from each upstream partner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume social-commerce inflows from TikTok Shop with fragmented counterparty details
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: TikTok Shop seller account verification, platform payout statements, order-level transaction ledger, refund/cancellation policy, product sourcing invoices, courier/logistics records, and a reconciled periodic cash-flow summary showing genuine e-commerce activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid circular or in-and-out movement without visible economic substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan, supplier agreements, inventory purchase invoices, end-customer sales invoices, storage or fulfilment contracts, tax residency evidence for pass-through partners, and a signed treasury-flow memorandum explaining the commercial rationale for each major transaction corridor.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route all inbound capital contributions and TikTok Shop settlement proceeds through SWIFT MT103 from the settlement provider's bank account to a GFSC-regulated Gibraltar bank beneficiary account. Acceptable remittance types include direct platform payouts from TikTok Shop and Wise B2B cross-border transfers; the remittance advice must state purpose code for trade in goods or operating contribution and reference the applicable invoice, settlement statement, or capital contribution certificate. Banks will require verification of the source account, the ultimate beneficial owner, and a reconciliation file matching each inbound wire to an identifiable marketplace order batch. Crypto-currency or unvetted virtual-asset intermediaries are not acceptable clearing rails for this structure.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 for supplier disbursements under open-account trade invoices, ensuring the payment narrative contains the purchase order and invoice reference. For high-value inventory purchases exceeding GBP 20,000 equivalent, an irrevocable commercial Letter of Credit at sight through the supplier's confirming bank is the preferred rail; documentary collections on a documents-against-payment basis may be used for repeated counterparties. All outbound payments must be matched to trade documents including the invoice, packing list, bill of lading or waybill, and certificate of origin, retained in the compliance file for bank review.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/GBP plain-vanilla forward contracts with licensed Gibraltar counterparties
USD/GBP non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed under an ISDA Master Agreement
USD/GBP cross-currency swaps for bilateral treasury or trade-finance purposes

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return Filing of an Exempted Limited Partnership under the Gibraltar Companies Act 2014 (as applied to limited partnerships) and the Limited Partnerships Act 2014
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Gibraltar Registrar of Companies, Companies House Gibraltar, 2nd Floor, 55-57 Irish Town, Gibraltar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing due within 42 calendar days after each anniversary of the ELP's registration date; no extension is statutorily available
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of £10 per day up to a cap of £1,000; persistent failure after 90 days may trigger Registrar's notice of intention to strike off, with administrative dissolution after further 60 days

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation Statement confirming register of members, registered office, general partner details, and compliance status
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Gibraltar Registrar of Companies, Companies House Gibraltar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same anniversary date as the Annual Return; confirmation statement may be combined and filed simultaneously with the Annual Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing is a criminal offence by the General Partner with fines on conviction up to £5,000; the Registrar may also initiate compulsory strike-off proceedings after written warning and 60-day non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Gibraltar Income Tax Return (Form GI-ELP) for the exempted limited partnership, including partner-level pass-through allocations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: HM Government of Gibraltar Income Tax Office, 5th Floor, City Hall, Grand Ocean Plaza, Gibraltar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due 30 November following the end of the tax year (calendar year basis); e-filing portal deadline is 30 November, with an administrative extension to 31 December available upon online application
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Initial penalty of £100 for late filing; further escalating penalties up to £1,000 plus interest on unpaid tax at 8% per annum; persistent default may result in tax assessments raised on a best-of-judgment basis and enforcement through the Collector of Revenue

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office Annual Retention Confirmation to the licensed Corporate Services Provider confirming the ELP maintains a physical registered office in Gibraltar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed fiduciary / Corporate Services Provider (on behalf of the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission registry record)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On the anniversary of the registered office engagement, typically 30 calendar days before the Annual Return filing deadline to permit internal review
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to confirm the registered office results in the Corporate Services Provider being statutorily obliged to file a cessation notice; the ELP loses its registered office and is subject to Registrar strike-off proceedings under Section 365 of the Companies Act 2014

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register Annual Review and update confirmation under the Beneficial Ownership (Access and Security) Regulations 2022
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Gibraltar Registrar of Companies, Central Beneficial Ownership Register Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous obligation; mandatory confirmation filing within 14 calendar days of any change; annual review certification no later than the ELP's Annual Return filing date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to £50,000 and/or imprisonment of up to 12 months for the General Partner for non-compliance on conviction; late notification of changes carries daily default penalties of £250 per day

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An Exempted Limited Partnership is required to produce audited financial statements if it meets any of the following: (a) is itself a subsidiary of a holding company whose consolidated group is subject to mandatory audit; (b) average number of employees during the financial year exceeds 50; (c) annual turnover exceeds GBP 10.2 million; (d) balance-sheet total exceeds GBP 5.1 million; (e) a limited partner or the General Partner requests an audit in the partnership agreement. Below these thresholds, an audit exemption is available under Section 4A of the Companies (Accounts) Act 2014 if the ELP qualifies as small and files an unaudited balance sheet with the Registrar.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Gibraltar has no domestic general-purpose GAAP; recognised frameworks are International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted by the EU, IFRS for SMEs, or the Financial Reporting Standard 102 (FRS 102) on the basis of Section 71 of the Companies Act 2014. For ISIC 4791 TikTok Shop retail activities, IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers applies to commission-based marketplace revenue recognition.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The ELP is required to take reasonable steps to identify all individuals with significant control or limited partnership beneficiary interests exceeding 25% of capital or profit entitlement. On the annual confirmation date, the General Partner must (i) review the internal beneficial ownership register; (ii) obtain written confirmation from each limited partner of any transfer or pledge of partnership interests during the year; (iii) record in the Central Beneficial Ownership Register any changes within 14 days of each shareholding or partnership-interest transfer; and (iv) certify the completeness of the register at the time of the Annual Return filing. Transfers of limited partnership interests are effective only upon entry into the register, which constitutes constructive notice to third parties.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members / Register of Limited Partners
Register of Directors / Register of General Partner
Register of Charges (if any partnership interest is charged)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 - USD 2,800 per annum for licensed fiduciary, registered office, and Corporate Services Provider compliance support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 - USD 8,500 for a certified audit of a digitally operating retail ELP under IFRS for SMEs, assuming a low transaction volume with TikTok Shop payout rails

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Gibraltar grants no statutory tax holidays or preferential corporate rate reductions. An Exempted Limited Partnership is tax-transparent under Gibraltar law; the ELP itself is not charged to corporation tax, and each partner is assessed on the allocated share of profits. There is no capital gains tax, no VAT, no branch profits tax, and no remittance charge on profits derived from outside Gibraltar. A partner resident in Gibraltar is taxable at the 12.5% company/individual trading rate applicable to income arising from the ELP.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Gibraltar Corporation Tax Return Form CT-1, filed through the Gibraltar Income Tax Office e-filing portal (iTax / Online Self-Assessment), accessible via the HM Government of Gibraltar tax administration website.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; quarterly provisional payments on account may be directed by the Commissioner of Income Tax for high-income taxpayers.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Gibraltar tax/assessment year runs from 1 July to 30 June. A CT-1 return notice is issued after the year of assessment; the return must be filed no later than 31 December of the calendar year in which the tax year ends. For the assessment year 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2025, the filing deadline is 31 December 2025. Non-resident ELPs are subject to the same statutory deadline with no administrative extension.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The Gibraltar-assigned tax file reference number registered on the Income Tax Register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Gibraltar-issued TRN for the ELP or, if no distinct TRN has been issued, use the general partner's TRN and mark the filing as a transparent partnership return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 – Legal Name and Tax Residence
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name of the ELP, registered office, principal place of effective management, and indication of Gibraltar residence status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ELPs must state the overseas place of effective management and may not use the Gibraltar registered office as the substantive residence address. Investors' residential addresses must not be inserted here.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The 1 July to 30 June tax year covered by the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the relevant assessment year; non-resident ELPs follow the same Gibraltar tax-year period regardless of foreign accounting periods.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: ISIC or industry code describing the economic activity of the ELP.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select ISIC 4791 / NAICS 454110 for TikTok Shop retail and other digital commerce. A non-resident ELP that carries on all management and commercial activity outside Gibraltar should describe itself accordingly and mark the return as a filing-only transparent partnership return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross amounts arising from e-commerce sales, live-stream retail commissions, platform incentive payments, and TikTok Shop payouts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross proceeds in pounds sterling or Gibraltar pounds, converted at the prevailing central-bank rate. Non-resident ELPs include only profits attributable to a Gibraltar permanent establishment or Gibraltar-source trading activity; third-party platform sales collected abroad are generally treaty-exempt unless management is exercised from Gibraltar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 – Allowable Deductions and Expensed Costs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold, platform commissions, transaction fees, payment-processing charges, marketing spend, licensed-content fees, and substantiated logistics expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductible expenditure must be wholly and exclusively incurred for the ELP's trade and be supported by invoices and bank statements. Non-resident ELPs must exclude any repayments to related parties unless arm's length transfer-pricing documentation is available.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount of prior-year assessed losses claimed against the current assessment year's profits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the loss-carryforward limitation period of five years. A non-resident partner may only utilise ELP losses to the extent permitted by the partner's residence jurisdiction; Gibraltar transparency does not transfer losses into a foreign return automatically.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed taxable result, after deductions and loss relief.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a tax-transparent ELP with only non-resident partners and no Gibraltar permanent establishment, this amount will be nil or nil after treaty relief; the ELP must nevertheless file the return with a nil declaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of Gibraltar corporation tax at the statutory rate on the Box 8 profit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the ELP is treated as transparent, no corporation tax is shown unless the partnership itself is separately assessable for administrative purposes. Any partnership-level tax shown is to be nil where partners are non-resident and no permanent establishment exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 10 – Double Taxation Relief / Foreign Tax Credit
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Relief claimed for foreign withholding taxes and, where applicable, treaty deductions under a double taxation agreement.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the relevant Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the partner's jurisdiction and complete the treaty-relief schedule if foreign taxes were withheld on TikTok Shop payouts or royalty income. No claim may be made without a valid TRC and documentary evidence of the foreign tax paid.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 11 – Tax Payable or Refund Due
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final balance of Gibraltar tax due after credits and pre-payments, or refund due.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ELPs claiming nil treaty status must insert zero. If a refund is claimed on account of foreign withholding tax credits, the supporting vouchers must be uploaded to iTax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration by the general partner, manager, or licensed Gibraltar tax agent stating the return is complete and accurate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The general partner or an authorised director of the corporate general partner must sign. If a licensed agent signs, a signed power of attorney and client due-diligence file must be retained.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of Form CT-1 triggers an automatic late-filing penalty of up to GIP 1,000, with a daily surcharge of GIP 50 per day up to a maximum cumulative surcharge of GIP 10,000. Incorrect returns, where not filed under reasonable care, are subject to penalties of up to 100% of the tax undercharged; deliberate evasion can double that percentage and trigger criminal investigation. Unpaid tax carries interest at 8% per annum from the original due date. Failure to file a nil transparent-entity return is still a default and will result in the Commissioner making a best-of-judgment assessment with penalties.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% – Gibraltar does not impose any withholding tax on dividends. Distributions to ELP partners are outside the Gibraltar income tax charge when paid or credited.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Although Gibraltar has an extremely limited double taxation agreement network, the applicable DTA protocols generally operate by exemption rather than by reduced statutory withholding. To invoke treaty relief, the beneficial owner of the income must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the revenue authority of the treaty partner state and submit the original TRC to the Gibraltar Income Tax Office alongside Form DTA-1/T-RELIEF, a signed certificate of beneficial ownership, and underlying distribution/interest vouchers. The claim must be made before the filing deadline; otherwise the exemption may be refused and the local 0% rate remains the only protection. For UK partners, relief is secured through the UK-Gibraltar double taxation arrangement by filing a UK HMRC residence certificate and the Gibraltar return records; no advance clearance is required.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Gibraltar's statutory withholding rate for royalties and debt interest paid to non-residents is 0%. Under the UK-Gibraltar and other limited DTA treaties, the withholding rate is likewise 0% or not chargeable, provided the recipient is the beneficial owner and a valid TRC is lodged. Payments to connected persons remain subject to the arm's length principle and transfer-pricing adjustment; a 0% statutory rate does not authorise artificial base-erosion payments.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: A Gibraltar Local / Master File documentation obligation is triggered where the Gibraltar entity belongs to a multinational group with consolidated annual revenue exceeding GIP 750,000,000 / EUR 750,000,000. In addition, a country-by-country report threshold applies at the same group revenue level. A de minimis local-file requirement is applied for related-party transactions: Gibraltar operations with aggregate controlled transaction value exceeding GIP 10,000,000 per tax year must contemporaneously document the controlled transactions, commercial rationale, selection of transfer-pricing method, and arm's length benchmarking.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Gibraltar applies an Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) regime under the International Tax Co-operation (Economic Substance) Act 2019, as amended. Any ELP deriving relevant income from e-commerce, distribution and service centre activity carried on in or from Gibraltar must satisfy the core income-generating activities (CIGA) test in Gibraltar: maintain a physical office, have adequate staff, incur sufficient local expenditure, and ensure strategic decisions are taken by partners or directors meeting in Gibraltar. The ELP must file an annual economic substance declaration with the Commissioner; a low-risk social-commerce entity with real personnel and inventory management will generally pass, but a pass-through ELP used solely as an invoice-milking shell is subject to substance failure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately under-reporting TikTok Shop gross receipts, treating personal withdrawals as deductible expenses, omitting platform incentive payments, manufacturing supplier invoices, or claiming treaty exemptions without genuine foreign residency, while managing the business from Gibraltar or the UK.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil penalties of up to 200% of the tax evaded, plus interest at 8% per annum. Criminal conviction on indictment carries a fine of up to GIP 250,000 and/or imprisonment up to six years; proceeds of tax fraud may be confiscated under the Proceeds of Crime Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil will be pierced where the ELP is used as a sham or cloak for fraud. The general partner, the directors of the corporate general partner, and the ultimate beneficial owner are jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax, may face asset-freezing orders, travel bans, and up to six years' imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining only a nominee registered office in Gibraltar, with no staff, no physical presence, no local books, and policy and decision-making carried out in Hong Kong, Dubai, or mainland UK while claiming Gibraltar tax transparency or treaty benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: A formal ESR finding of non-compliance triggers financial penalties of up to GIP 100,000, a daily default penalty of GIP 2,000, cancellation of the ELP's registration at the Gibraltar Companies Registry, and a mandatory disclosure to the UK revenue authorities and OECD exchange of information network.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of the general partner are personally liable for knowingly making false substance declarations. Courts may issue director disqualification orders, international travel restrictions, and impose personal restitution orders over diverted profits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Adjustment and BEPS Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying inflated platform commissions, management fees, royalty fees, or inventory mark-ups to connected Cayman or Hong Kong entities; stripping all margin out of the Gibraltar ELP without arm's length benchmarks; failing to submit Local File / CbC report at the applicable group threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Commissioner will reconstruct the transaction at arm's length, assess additional tax at 12.5% plus an offshore penalty equal to 100% of the understated profit, and charge 8% interest. Non-filing of country-by-country or master-file documentation attracts a penalty of GIP 10,000 per month of delay, with unlimited fines on conviction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers who sign or direct false transfer-pricing documentation bear civil liability for the alignment of intra-group pricing; criminal liability arises where documents are fabricated. Director disqualification, confiscation orders, and up to three years' imprisonment may be imposed for wilful misconduct.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering / Sanctions and AML Breach
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Channeling TikTok Shop payouts through Wise B2B or other payment rails to pay sanctioned parties or to conceal the beneficial owner's identity; failing to conduct customer due diligence; using bearer structures or unreported nominees to hold partnership interests.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Sanctions under the Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering framework carry civil penalties up to GIP 500,000 per breach, asset-freezing and forfeiture orders; where money laundering is proven, imprisonment up to seven years, unlimited fines, and publication on the Gibraltar FIU sanctions register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The general partner and directors of any corporate partner are personally liable for AML failures. Individual officers face criminal prosecution, permanent disqualification from regulated activities, travel bans while investigations are active, and personal civil liability for damages arising from the proceeds of crime.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Retaining customer seller balances for more than settlement periods, holding third-party funds, granting credit or operating as a payment institution without a Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) electronic-money institution licence or banking licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offence under the Financial Services (Banking) Act and Electronic Money Regulations, punishable on conviction by a fine of up to GIP 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to five years; the GFSC may issue a winding-up petition and require repatriation of all client funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the general partner are personally and jointly liable for debts arising from unlawful deposit-taking. Personal asset-confiscation orders, disqualification from holding office in a regulated financial entity, five-year travel bans, and imprisonment are typical outcomes.
